curl -fsSL https://files.dthompson.us/haunt/haunt-0.3.0.tar.gz | tar -xz && curl -fsSL https://github.com/OrangeShark/guile-commonmark/archive/refs/tags/v0.1.2.tar.gz | tar -xz && sed 's|@GUILE@|/usr/bin/guile|g; s|@guilemoduledir@|/build/haunt-0.3.0|g; s|@guileobjectdir@|/build/haunt-0.3.0|g' haunt-0.3.0/scripts/haunt.in > /usr/local/bin/haunt && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/haunt && printf '(define-module (haunt config)
  #:export (%%haunt-version %%rsync %%hut %%tar))
(define %%haunt-version "0.3.0")
(define %%rsync "rsync")
(define %%hut "hut")
(define %%tar "tar")
' > haunt-0.3.0/haunt/config.scm
